A bolder outfit that serves her better wins over a quieter one with fewer remarks.","A finding with «register» «gate» stops the outfit unless you accept it: if the outfit you choose has gates, accept each of them in «accept» with why it serves her here. That is your weighed decision and not a reason to pass over the outfit.","You may also keep a remark on purpose: in «accept», name its existing «id» from «remarks_by_code», with a non-empty «why». A section with item gives the vector for that single item. null means no knowledge supplied. Vector indices refer to facts in property order. defaults is the explicit complete three-index vector: append its trailing indices to a shorter vector; a scalar is a one-index vector. Applicability is independent of status; unknown never proves NA. measured: known value from that source; range: only that window/alternatives; unknown: no supported fact; not_applicable: explicit inapplicability.
